description: This file defines a timezone-aware Date object (`timezoneJS.Date`) with support for timezone calculations, serialization, and zone info retrieval, along with timezone data management functions.

classes.name: timezoneJS.Date
classes.description: A constructor function that mimics the native Date object but adds timezone support, serialization, and custom formatting.

methods.name: setFromDateObjProxy
methods.description: Initializes the custom Date object from a native Date object.

methods.name: setFromTimeProxy
methods.description: Initializes the custom Date object from UTC milliseconds and timezone.

methods.name: getTzInfo
methods.description: Retrieves timezone offset and abbreviation for a given date and timezone.
